description: Source code for thread-specific data (TSD) management in jemalloc, including thread initialization, cleanup, state management, and platform-specific thread handling.

methods.name: tsd_in_nominal_list
methods.description: Checks if a given tsd is in the nominal list.

methods.name: tsd_add_nominal
methods.description: Adds a tsd to the nominal list.

methods.name: tsd_remove_nominal
methods.description: Removes a tsd from the nominal list.

methods.name: tsd_force_recompute
methods.description: Forces recomputation of tsd states across threads.

methods.name: tsd_global_slow_inc
methods.description: Increments the global slow-path feature count and triggers recompute.

methods.name: tsd_global_slow_dec
methods.description: Decrements the global slow-path feature count and triggers recompute.

methods.name: tsd_local_slow
methods.description: Checks if a tsd is in a slow state locally.

methods.name: tsd_global_slow
methods.description: Checks if any slow-path features are enabled globally.

methods.name: tsd_state_compute
methods.description: Computes the current state of a tsd based on global and local conditions.

methods.name: tsd_slow_update
methods.description: Updates the tsd's state based on current conditions.

methods.name: tsd_state_set
methods.description: Sets the state of a tsd, updating list membership accordingly.

methods.name: tsd_data_init
methods.description: Initializes tsd data structures, including rtree context and tcache.

methods.name: assert_tsd_data_cleanup_done
methods.description: Asserts that tsd data cleanup has been completed.

methods.name: tsd_data_init_nocleanup
methods.description: Initializes tsd data without cleanup, used during reincarnation.

methods.name: tsd_fetch_slow
methods.description: Fetches or initializes thread-specific data in slow path.

methods.name: malloc_tsd_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory aligned to cache line size.

methods.name: malloc_tsd_dalloc
methods.description: Deallocates memory allocated by malloc_tsd_malloc.

methods.name: _malloc_thread_cleanup
methods.description: Performs thread cleanup, calling registered cleanup functions.

methods.name: malloc_tsd_cleanup_register
methods.description: Registers a cleanup function to be called during thread cleanup.

methods.name: tsd_cleanup
methods.description: Per-thread cleanup function, handles cleanup of thread-specific data.

methods.name: malloc_tsd_boot0
methods.description: Initializes thread-specific data subsystem, including mutexes.

methods.name: malloc_tsd_boot1
methods.description: Completes initialization of thread-specific data subsystem.

methods.name: tsd_prefork
methods.description: Prepares thread-specific data for fork.

methods.name: tsd_postfork_parent
methods.description: Post-fork handling for parent process.

methods.name: tsd_postfork_child
methods.description: Post-fork handling for child process, reinitializing thread-specific data.
